goal: flywheel init prints one copy-pasteable CLAUDE.md pointer line naming the flywheel-ops skill and fw docs, and provably never creates or modifies a root CLAUDE.md.

graders.name: suggestion-printed
graders.run: WT="$PWD" && T=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$T" && git init -qb main && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm root --allow-empty && uv run --project "$WT" flywheel init --defaults > out.txt 2>&1; grep -q 'flywheel-ops' out.txt && grep -q 'fw docs' out.txt

graders.name: claudemd-untouched
graders.run: WT="$PWD" && T=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$T" && git init -qb main && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm root --allow-empty && uv run --project "$WT" flywheel init --defaults >/dev/null 2>&1; test ! -f CLAUDE.md || { echo 'init created CLAUDE.md'; exit 1; }; T2=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$T2" && git init -qb main && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm root --allow-empty && printf 'operator content\n' > CLAUDE.md && H=$(md5sum < CLAUDE.md) && uv run --project "$WT" flywheel init --defaults >/dev/null 2>&1; test "$(md5sum < CLAUDE.md)" = "$H" || { echo 'init modified CLAUDE.md'; exit 1; }

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- init's next-steps output, where the suggestion line joins
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_init.py -- keep green; extend for the suggestion and the no-touch guarantee
constraints: One line, copy-pasteable, naming both 'flywheel-ops' and 'fw docs'; printed on interactive AND --defaults paths
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Never write, create, or reformat CLAUDE.md -- printing the suggestion is the entire feature (spec 00072 D-3)
Do not add new init flags
Do not weaken or delete existing tests
edge_cases: Re-running init prints the same suggestion again (printing is stateless; only file writes are idempotent-guarded)
